1. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, wherein said electronics module is disposed within the columnar body and communicates directly with the base member through a connector.

2. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open.

5. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are spaced at predetermined intervals around the columnar body.

6. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are positioned at uniformly distributed intervals relative to said diodes.

10. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode is mounted on each face.

11. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 150 W/mK.

13. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises a base selected from the group consisting of an Edison screw base and a wedge base.

16. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 150 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline.
